options.label: Yes, the agent rewords it

options.description: Such a question goes back to the judge once, as you agreed on 2026-10-17; if it fails again it waits in a debug case.
options.label: No, the judge redoes it

payload.question: On 2026-10-17 you agreed that a judge question using plumb's own words (a record number, a plumb term) is sent back to the judge to be redone once. Since your complaint that such a question was set aside to the band, it now goes straight to the agent, who puts it in your words and asks you; only a question missing its answer choices is redone. Does that change stand?
